title: Parrot dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ee8ff' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5ee8ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow behind -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- tail feathers fanning behind -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='78' rx='6' ry='16' fill='#2fd4c8' transform='rotate(-28 26 78)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='82' rx='6' ry='17' fill='#3ee6b0' transform='rotate(-10 34 82)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='84' rx='5' ry='13' fill='#6cf07a' transform='rotate(4 44 84)'/>

  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M44 78 L38 90' stroke='#f2a33c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M56 78 L64 88' stroke='#f7c04a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M34 90 L38 90 L42 92' stroke='#f2a33c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 88 L64 88 L70 89' stroke='#f7c04a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='20' ry='23' fill='#37c85c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='12' ry='15' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- left wing raised up and out -->
  <path d='M32 50 Q16 38 20 24 Q32 34 40 46 Z' fill='#2f9be0'/>
  <path d='M22 26 Q30 36 37 46' stroke='#6cd0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right wing raised down-out -->
  <path d='M68 52 Q84 46 88 32 Q74 40 64 48 Z' fill='#2f9be0'/>
  <path d='M86 34 Q76 44 66 48' stroke='#6cd0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='15' fill='#43d96a'/>
  <!-- cheek patch -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='5' fill='#ffd0e0'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='29' r='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='29' r='2.4' fill='#3a2b6b'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='28' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M63 30 Q74 30 74 37 Q74 42 65 41 Q60 40 62 35 Z' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
  <path d='M63 36 Q70 37 73 36' stroke='#ffcf66' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little crest feathers -->
  <path d='M40 20 Q42 12 48 16' stroke='#6cf07a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 18 Q52 10 56 16' stroke='#a6ff8f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- music notes around -->
  <g fill='#5ee8ff'>
    <circle cx='18' cy='20' r='3'/>
    <rect x='20' y='10' width='2' height='11'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <rect x='84' y='12' width='2' height='11'/>
  </g>
</svg>
